errors.text_span: 左侧图表包含七个切片
errors.evidence: The left pie chart contains eight slices, not seven.

errors.text_span: 右侧的图表同样包含七个切片
errors.evidence: The right pie chart contains eight slices, not seven.
The machine description incorrectly states the percentages for the slices of the left chart. Correct values are: 37%, 0%, 18%, 16%, 17%, 6%, 3%, 3%.
The machine description incorrectly states the percentages for the slices of the right chart. Correct values are: 21%, 8%, 29%, 21%, 6%, 9%, 6%.
Does not mention that the slices have consistent coloring between the two charts.
Does not clearly state that the charts show the distribution of error types across sliding window and NTC deficiencies.
